response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (AVG(derived_product_cost) - AVG(derived_total_cost)) / AVG(derived_total_cost) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.rel_gap AS relative_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_average FROM inv, overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10
